description_en: Retrieves a list of data access policies
description_zh: 获取数据接入策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-data-ingestions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --data-ingestion-ids alibaba_cloud_sas_netstat_ingestion_1733260000000 --data-ingestion-status enabled --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --data-ingestion-template-ids alibaba_cloud_sas_netstat_ingestion --normalization-schema-ids NETWORK_SESSION_ACTIVITY --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataIngestions

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis feature is deployed. Select the region that corresponds to the location of your asset. Valid values:

`cn-hangzhou`: Your asset is in the Chinese mainland.

`ap-southeast-1`: Your asset is in a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to query data as the specified member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: An array of data ingestion policy IDs
parameters.name: data_ingestion_ids

parameters.help_en:
The data ingestion status. Valid values:

`enabled`: Enabled.

`disabled`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
数据接入状态。取值：
enabled：启用。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: data_ingestion_status

parameters.help_en: An array of data ingestion template IDs
parameters.name: data_ingestion_template_ids

parameters.help_en: An array of normalization schema IDs
parameters.name: normalization_schema_ids
